text: 中国人民银行信贷市场司副司长车士义：截至今年二季度末，全国本外币服务业中长期贷款余额76.22万亿元，同比增长6.4%，增速比各项贷款高1.3个百分点，金融支持服务业发展取得明显成
text_en: Che Shiyi, Deputy Director of the PBOC Credit Market Department: As of the end of Q2 this year, the outstanding medium- and long-term domestic and foreign currency loans to the service industry nationwide reached 76.22 trillion yuan, up 6.4% year-on-year, 1.3 percentage points higher than the growth rate of all loans, and financial support for service industry development has achieved notable results
